questions.stem: —Why didn’t you come to my birthday party yesterday?—Sorry, I was so busy that I _______ forgot it.
questions.expl: 句意：--你昨天为什么没来参加我的生日聚会？----对不起，我太忙了，以至于我完全忘了。 A. suddenly 突然地；B. completely 完全地，彻底地；C. recently 最近地；D. quietly 安静地，悄悄地。 根据上文“没来参加生日聚会”可知“忙得完全忘了”，故选B。

questions.stem: Millions of people ________ cancer from all over the world every year and more and more people_______ car accidents because of the heavy traffic.
questions.expl: 句意：每年全世界数百万的人死于癌症，越来越多的人因为交通拥堵死于交通事故。 考查动词短语辨析。die from 死于(某种外因，也可用于疾病、过度悲伤等)；die out 灭绝，逐渐 消亡；die of 死于(疾病、过度悲伤，也可用于外因等)；die upon 死在。根据题干中“cancer”癌 症可知是疾病，应用die of；题干中的“car accidents”意为车祸，属于某种外在原因，故用die from。 故选C。

questions.stem: —Hey, have you seen the latest short videos on Douyin?—Sure! I often spend my free time ________ them.
questions.expl: 句意：——嘿，你看过抖音上最新的短视频吗？——当然！我经常花空闲时间观看它们。 考查非谓语动词。spend time doing sth“花费时间做某事”，动词短语，因此此处应用动名词形式， 在句中作宾语。故选B。

questions.stem: There isn’t ________ paper in the box. Will you go and get ________ for me?
questions.expl: 句意：盒子里没有纸。你能去给我拿一些吗？ 考查some 和any 的用法。第一个句子是否定句，用any；第二个句子是疑问句，希望得到肯定回 答，用some。故选A。

questions.stem: The new work is so difficult that ________ can finish it.
questions.expl: 句意：这项新工作太难了，没有人能完成。 考查代词辨析。everybody 每个人；nobody 没有人；anybody 任何人；somebody 某人。根据“The new work is so difficult that...can finish it.”可知工作太难了，没有人能完成。故选B。

questions.stem: —Would you like ________ books to read?—Oh, great! I’d like to read ________. It can make the waiting time more enjoyable.
questions.expl: 句意：——你想要看一些书吗？——哦，太棒了！我想读一些有趣的东西。它可以使等待 时间更愉快。 考查不定代词。some 一些，常用于肯定句中，但也用于期望得到肯定回答的疑问句中；any 一些， 常用于否定句和疑问句中。第一个空位于期望得到肯定回答的疑问句中，用some；复合不定代词 和形容词连用时，形容词要位于复合不定代词后，作后置定语，第二个空填something interesting。 故选A。

questions.stem: —What do you think of your teacher?—He is perfect and plays an important role ________ helping us in our school life.
questions.expl: 句意：——你觉得你们的老师怎么样？——他很好，并且在帮助我们的学习生活中起着重 要作用。 考查介词的辨析。on 在……之上；up 向上；in 在……中；with 和……一起。play an important role in...表示“在……中起着重要作用”，固定短语。故选C。

questions.stem: —I need some energy for ________ afternoon.—You can have a big lunch now.
questions.expl: 句意：——我整个下午都需要一些能量。——你现在可以吃一顿丰盛的午餐了。 考查形容词辨析。all 所有的；whole 整个的。the whole afternoon“整个下午”，固定短语，故选D。

questions.stem: —I think friends should be different ________ each other.—I don’t agree (同意) with you. I think friends should be similar ________ each other.
questions.expl: 句意：——我认为朋友彼此之间应该有所不同。——我不同意你的看法。我认为朋友彼此 之间应该有相似之处。 考查介词辨析。from 来自；to 到；in 在……里面；as 作为。根据“be different...each other”可知，be different from 意为“和……不同”，第一空使用from，表示朋友之间应该是不同的；根据“be similar...each other”可知，be similar to 意为“和……相似”，第二空使用to，表示朋友之间应该是相 似的；be similar in“在某方面有相似之处”，用在此处不符合语境。故选A。

questions.stem: Can you give me ________ on it?
questions.expl: 句意：你能给我一些建议吗？ 考查不可数名词和不定代词。advice“建议”为不可数名词，没有复数形式，排除A、B；表示“一些” 时，some 常用于肯定句或期望得到肯定回答的疑问句，而any 常用于否定和疑问句中。本句为寻 求建议的疑问句，符合使用some 的情境，故选D。 二、完形填空(本大题共10 小题，每小题1 分，满分10 分) 阅读下面短文，从每小题A、B、C、D 中选出一个能填入文章中相应空白处的最佳答案。 In the fast-changing world of technology, Liang Wenfeng is a rising star. He founded DeepSeek, an AI company that has made a great 11 to the world. Liang Wenfeng was born in the 1980s in a small town in Guangdong. From a young age, he showed great 12 in maths and computers. He studied hard and got into Zhejiang University, where he got both his bachelor’s and master’s degrees (学位) in 13 science. After finishing school, Liang Wenfeng began working in banking and money-related jobs. He started an investment team that used AI to help with their work. This made him famous. However, he was not satisfied with this success. He realized that AI could be helpful in many ways and decided to make a big 14. In 2023, he 15 DeepSeek. He put a lot of effort (努力) and money into 16 AI technologies. DeepSeek’s goal is to 17 AI models that can compete with the best in the world. And it has achieved great success. Its AI models are great at understanding and using language. They can 18 different kinds of questions, help with writing, and even write code (代码). What’s more, these models don’t cost much, which makes them very 19.

questions.stem: A．form
questions.expl: ：他创立了DeepSeek，这是一家对世界产生巨大影响的人工智能公司。 form 形式；difference 差异；change 改变；decision 决定。根据“He founded DeepSeek, an AI company that has made a great...to the world.”可知，此处应用短语make a difference“起作用，有影响”，表示 DeepSeek 这家公司对世界有巨大影响。故选B。

questions.stem: A．skill
questions.expl: ：他从小在数学和计算机方面展现出非凡的天赋。 skill 技能；knowledge 知识；improvement 进步；talent 天赋。根据下文“..got into Zhejiang University, where he got both his bachelor’s and master’s degrees...”推测，他能在计算机领域深耕，说明他是有天 赋的。故选D。

questions.stem: A．computer
questions.expl: ：他努力学习，考上了浙江大学，并在那里获得了计算机科学学士和硕士学位。 computer 计算机；technology 技术；physics 物理；chemistry 化学。根据上文“he showed great talent in maths and computers”可知，他在数学和计算机方面有天赋，大学应该会选择计算机方面的专业。 故选A。

questions.stem: A．charge
questions.expl: ：他意识到人工智能可以在很多方面提供帮助，并决定做出重大改变。 charge 收费；choice 选择；change 改变；chance 机会。根据上文“Liang Wenfeng began working in banking and money-related jobs.”和下文“He put a lot of effort (努力) and money into...AI technologies.” 可知，梁文峰以前从事银行和货币相关的工作，后来从事科技工作，说明他做出了改变。故选C。

questions.stem: A．set off
questions.expl: ：2023 年，他创立了DeepSeek。 set off 出发；set down 写下；set up 创立；set in 开始。根据上文“He founded DeepSeek”可知，他创 立了DeepSeek 这个公司。故选C。

questions.stem: A．spreading
questions.expl: ：他投入大量精力与资金研发AI 技术。 spreading 传播；developing 研发；improving 改进；making 制造。根据下文“DeepSeek’s goal is to...AI models that can compete with the best in the world.”可推测，他想让DeepSeek 成为世界顶尖水平，应 该要靠自主研发。故选B。

questions.stem: A．close
questions.expl: ：DeepSeek 的愿景是打造能与世界顶尖水平比肩的AI 大模型。 close 关闭；copy 复制；create 创造；invent 发明。根据“AI models”可知，此处指创造新模型。故选 C。 18．句意：这些模型能回答各类问题、辅助写作甚至编写代码。 make 制作；answer 回答；overlook 忽视；mind 介意。根据“different kinds of questions”可知，此处 指回答问题。故选B。

questions.stem: A．make
A．expensive
questions.expl: ：更重要的是，这些模型不贵，这使它们很受欢迎。 expensive 昂贵的；difficult 困难的；comfortable 舒适的；popular 受欢迎的。根据“these models don’t cost much”可知，模型物美价廉，应该会变得受欢迎。故选D。

questions.stem: A．invitation
questions.expl: ：DeepSeek 的成就使梁文峰受到全球科技界尊重。 invitation 邀请；achievements 成就；improvement 改进；advantages 优势。根据上文“And it has achieved great success.”可知，DeepSeek 取得了巨大的成功，achievements 符合文意。故选B。

questions.stem: Huang Xuhua decided to study hard to make the country strong because of the following EXCEPT______.
opts: He saw the hard times of his country under foreign attacks.
He wanted to develop nuclear submarines.
He had sad memories of his country’s difficulties.
He made a promise to use his knowledge to help the country.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“When he was young, he saw the hard times of his country under foreign attacks (侵略). These sad memories made him study hard. He made a promise to make the country strong with his knowledge.”可知，黄旭华决定努力学习是因为他目睹了国家在外敌侵略下的艰难处境，并立下 誓言要用知识使国家强大，他想发展核潜艇是他后来的具体行动而非最初动机，故选B。

questions.stem: In the 1950s, why did Huang Xuhua and his team didn’t contact with the outside world?
opts: Because they didn’t like communicating with others.
Because they wanted to focus on their personal lives.
To keep the secret of the nuclear submarine project.
To avoid the influence of outside opinions on their research.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“To keep the project secret, they stopped contacting (联系) the outside world, even their families.”可知，停止与外界联系是为了保密核潜艇项目，故选C。

questions.stem: What can we infer (推断) about Huang Xuhua’s team during the project?
opts: They depended heavily on foreign technology.
They prioritized (优先) communication with their families.
They used basic tools due to limited resources.
They gave up after facing initial (最初的) difficulties.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“They used simple tools like abacuses and slide rules (算盘和滑尺) to calculate and do experiments with great effort.”可知，团队使用简陋的工具进行研究，故选C。

questions.stem: Huang Xuhua’s winning the “Medal of the Republic” in 2019 shows that ______.
opts: he was the only scientist who made great contributions (贡献) in China
his achievements and dedication (奉献) were highly recognized
the government wanted to give rewards to all scientists
it was easy for him to get such a high honor
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“His hard work and devotion won him many honors”可知，黄旭华获得“共和国 勋章”表明他的成就和奉献精神得到了高度认可，而不是因为他是唯一做出贡献的科学家或政府想 要奖励所有科学家，故选B。

questions.stem: The writer wants to tell us that ______.
opts: Huang Xuhua was a great scientist.
Huang Xuhua’s spirit should inspire us.
questions.expl: 大意题。根据“We, especially the young people, should learn from his spirit...In this way, his spirit will live on forever.”可知，作者意在号召人们传承黄旭华的精神，而非单纯的强调其成就或荣 誉，故选D。

questions.stem: What can we know about Helen Thayer?
opts: She has never been to the Amazon.
She visited the North Pole with her husband.
She was the first woman to travel alone to the North Pole.
She seldom shares stories of her traveling experiences with people.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“At the age of 50, she became the first woman to travel alone to the North Pole.” 可知，她是第一位独自前往北极的女性。故选C。

questions.stem: The Thayers met Mongolian nomads when they ________.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“They walked 1,600 miles in terrible heat across the Gobi Desert. There they met Mongolian nomads (游牧民) and learned about their culture.”可知，他们在穿越戈壁沙漠时遇到了蒙古 游牧民族。故选C。

questions.stem: The Thuyers ________ to celebrate their 50 years of marriage.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“To celebrate their 50 years of marriage, the Thayers walked almost 4,000 miles across the Sahara Desert to study the customs of the people who lived there.”可知，他们徒步穿越撒哈拉 沙漠来庆祝他们结婚50 周年。故选A。

questions.stem: Which of the following shows the structure (结构) of the text?
questions.expl: 结构题。根据文章内容可知，第一段介绍海伦·塞耶是一名探险家，她热爱挑战；第二至 四段具体介绍了她探险的经历；第五段总结上文，并给出她的建议——设定目标、制定计划并永不 放弃。故选A。

questions.stem: The best title for the passage can be ________.
opts: The Love Story of the Thayers
questions.expl: 标题题。通读全文可知，本文主要讲述了Helen Thayer 作为20 世纪最伟大的探险家之一 的探险经历和人生故事，因此D 项“海伦·塞耶，一位伟大的探险家”适合作标题。故选D。

questions.stem: What percent of the Chinese men are overweight or obese?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“It is said that about 41.1% of the Chinese men and 27.7% of the Chinese women are overweight or obese (肥胖的).”可知，大约41.1% 的中国男性过度肥胖或肥胖。故选A。

questions.stem: Mark’s BMI is 23, so what can we say?
questions.expl: 判断题。根据BMI 计算公式以及常识，BMI 在18.5 至24.9 之间通常被认为是正常范围。 由于Mark 的BMI 是23，所以我们可以说他体重正常。故选B。

questions.stem: Which of the following can be put in▲?
questions.expl: 判断题。根据下文“Eating too much. Some kinds of medicine. Poor sleep. Family history. Too much pressure”可知，这些都是导致肥胖的原因。因此，空白处应填入“Reasons for obesity 肥胖的原 因”。故选B。

questions.stem: Which is NOT in the list of “Ways to control your weight”?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据文中“Ways to control your weight”部分提到的“Drink a lot of water. Eat more fruit and vegetables. Exercise a lot. Keep an eye on your weight. Stay away from food with high sugar or fat. Relax and have enough sleep.”可知，这些方法中没有提到“Wear comfortable clothes.穿舒适的衣 服”。因此，选项D 是不在列表中的内容。故选D。

questions.stem: What does the text want to tell us?
opts: We should save water and food.
We should go to a doctor often.
We should do sports every day.
questions.expl: 句意：最初这是一间卧室，但我们把它改成了书房。根据句子结构，空格处应填副词修饰 整个句子，名词origin 的副词形式为originally，意为“最初”，且位于句首，首字母应大写。故填 Originally。
